step_definition: capsule clearance >=2mm and contact-off >=60ms then landing, foot travel >=5mm; first 0.5s excluded
step_definition_zh: 足底离地至少2mm并持续60ms，重新着地时足中心移动至少5mm；最初0.5秒不计。
domain: flat floor, explicit material_friction settings recorded below, deterministic policy, 0.015rad initial joint perturbation; simulation only

swing_peak_diagnostics.definition: Actual capsule-bottom peak within each complete planned swing after startup; no 60ms duration condition in this peak metric; no-lift swings are counted.

priority_diagnostics.body_contact_scope: Knee motor meshes are on hip_pitch rigid bodies; elbow meshes are on shoulder_pitch bodies. Net force may include self-contact; not a direct kneeling classifier.
priority_diagnostics.range_scope: Per-environment p95-p05 over actual joint samples, then median across environments.

knee_contact_rule.method: Existing knee motor collision primitives vs plane z=0, checked each 20ms control step; cylinder support bound conservative for tessellation

material_friction.combination: arithmetic mean, validated by isolated sliding deceleration
material_friction.scope: Temporary simulation materials; not hardware friction. Both batch arms have matched material remapping; non-foot/foot self-contact friction differs from parent.

hind20_diagnostics.definition: Each qualifying hind step retains2mm/60ms/5mm and additionally has actual capsule-bottom peak>20mm during the same air phase; takeoff after1s. No requirement to hold20mm for60ms.

all20_diagnostics.definition: All four feet: valid landed step with actual capsule-bottom peak>20mm in that air phase, clearance>=2mm for>=60ms and foot travel>=5mm; takeoff after1s.

stride_progress_diagnostics.definition: Forward displacement along takeoff heading for valid landed steps:20mm peak,2mm clearance60ms,atleast5mm forward placement,body forwardvelocity>5mm/s; startup excluded.

ankle_diagnostics.definition: All live samples after1s; per-environment median and p95-p05 range, then median over environments

velocity_tracking.definition: Body-frame measured velocity vs actual commands after initial1s, only while the original episode is alive. Group metrics are descriptive, time samples correlated.

friction_power_diagnostic.definition: Horizontal ground force on foot dotted with actual body horizontal velocity; positive along body motion.
friction_power_diagnostic.reason: Legacy net-contact and articulation sensor horizontal-force measurements failed known-load calibration. No per-foot power numbers published.

runtime_identity_scope: runtime_sha256 is the checkpoint training runtime; replay_source_files_sha256 identifies actual diagnostic replay sources and assets.
